                                            \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,   \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                                 \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                      \\\n        }                                                                      \\\n    } while (0)\n\nconstexpr size_t TILE = 32;       // CUDA thread-block edge\nconstexpr size_t GPU_CHUNK = 64;  // rows of C handed out per dynamic work item\n\n// Generate pseudo-random values for matrix initialization\nconstexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {\n    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);\n}\n\n// First row of the block owned by rank r of P (rows are split as evenly as possible)\nconstexpr size_t rowBegin(const size_t N, const size_t r, const size_t P) noexcept {\n    return N * r / P;\n}\n\n// Fill the rows [rowBegin, rowEnd) of the global matrix into a local block\nvoid initMatrixRows(std::vector<double>& mat, const size_t N, const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowEnd) {\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = rowBegin; i < rowEnd; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            mat[(i - rowBegin) * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, i, j);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// C[rows x N] = A[rows x N] * B[N x N]. Each C element accumulates its k-terms in\n// increasing k order, exactly as the sequential reference does, so results match it.\n__global__ void matmulKernel(const double* __restrict__ A, const double* __restrict__ B,\n                             double* __restrict__ C, const size_t rows, const size_t N) {\n    __shared__ double As[TILE][TILE];\n    __shared__ double Bs[TILE][TILE];\n\n    const size_t row = blockIdx.y * TILE + threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t col = blockIdx.x * TILE + threadIdx.x;\n    double sum = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t kt = 0; kt < N; kt += TILE) {\n        const size_t ka = kt + threadIdx.x;\n        const size_t kb = kt + threadIdx.y;\n        As[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x] = (row < rows && ka < N) ? A[row * N + ka] : 0.0;\n        Bs[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x] = (kb < N && col < N) ? B[kb * N + col] : 0.0;\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const size_t kmax = (N - kt < TILE) ? N - kt : TILE;\n        for (size_t kk = 0; kk < kmax; ++kk) {\n            sum += As[threadIdx.y][kk] * Bs[kk][threadIdx.x];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (row < rows && col < N) {\n        C[row * N + col] = sum;\n    }\n}\n\n// Drives one GPU: repeatedly claims a chunk of local rows and computes it on the device\nvoid gpuWorker(const int device, const double* Al, const double* B, double* Cl,\n               const size_t localRows, const size_t N, std::atomic<size_t>& nextRow) {\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));\n\n    const size_t chunkMax = std::min(GPU_CHUNK, localRows);\n    double *dA = nullptr, *dB = nullptr, *dC = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dA, chunkMax * N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dB, N * N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dC, chunkMax * N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dB, B, N * N * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const dim3 block(TILE, TILE);\n    for (size_t begin = nextRow.fetch_add(GPU_CHUNK); begin < localRows; begin = nextRow.fetch_add(GPU_CHUNK)) {\n        const size_t rows = std::min(GPU_CHUNK, localRows - begin);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dA, Al + begin * N, rows * N * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        const dim3 grid((N + TILE - 1) / TILE, (rows + TILE - 1) / TILE);\n        matmulKernel<<<grid, block>>>(dA, dB, dC, rows, N);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(Cl + begin * N, dC, rows * N * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dA));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dB));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dC));\n}\n\n// Computes this rank's rows of C on all of its GPUs, one OpenMP thread per GPU\nvoid computeLocalRows(const std::vector<int>& devices, const double* Al, const double* B,\n                      double* Cl, const size_t localRows, const size_t N) {\n    std::atomic<size_t> nextRow{0};\n    const int numWorkers = static_cast<int>(devices.size());\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static, 1) num_threads(numWorkers)\n    for (int d = 0; d < numWorkers; ++d) {\n        gpuWorker(devices[d], Al, B, Cl, localRows, N, nextRow);\n    }\n}\n\n// GPUs are split round-robin across the ranks of a node. When there are more ranks than\n// GPUs, ranks share a device.\nstd::vector<int> assignDevices(const int nodeRank, const int nodeSize, const int numDevices) {\n    std::vector<int> devices;\n    if (numDevices >= nodeSize) {\n        for (int d = nodeRank; d < numDevices; d += nodeSize) {\n            devices.push_back(d);\n        }\n    } else {\n        devices.push_back(nodeRank % numDevices);\n    }\n    return devices;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size N (computes NxN * NxN) (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Simple validation: compute a single element and compare.\n// A is regenerated from its generator, since the full A matrix is not kept on the root rank.\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& B, const std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) {\n    // Check a few random positions\n    constexpr size_t checkPoints[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4};\n\n    for (size_t pi = 0; pi < 5; ++pi) {\n        for (size_t pj = 0; pj < 5; ++pj) {\n            const size_t i = checkPoints[pi] % N;\n            const size_t j = checkPoints[pj] % N;\n\n            double expected = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                expected += getPseudoRndValue(N, i, k) * B[k * N + j];\n            }\n\n            const double actual = C[i * N + j];\n            const double relError = std::abs((actual - expected) / (expected + 1e-10));\n\n            if (relError > 1e-6) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at (%zu, %zu): expected %.10f, got %.10f (error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, j, expected, actual, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n    const bool root = (rank == 0);\n\n    size_t N = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if Each C element accumulates its k-terms in\n// increasing k order, exactly as the sequential reference does, so results match it.\n__global__ void matmulKernel(const double* __restrict__ A, const double* __restrict__ B,\n                             double* __restrict__ C, const size_t rows, const size_t N) {\n    __shared__ double As[TILE][TILE];\n    __shared__ double Bs[TILE][TILE];\n\n    const size_t row = blockIdx.y * TILE + threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t col = blockIdx.x * TILE + threadIdx.x;\n    double sum = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t kt = 0; kt < N; kt += TILE) {\n        const size_t ka = kt + threadIdx.x;\n        const size_t kb = kt + threadIdx.y;\n        As[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x] = (row < rows && ka < N) ? <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Generate pseudo-random values for matrix initialization\nconstexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {\n    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);\n}\n\nvoid initMatrix(std::vector<double>& mat, const size_t N) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            mat[i * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, i, j);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid matrixMultiply(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B, \n                    std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                sum += A[i * N + k] * B[k * N + j];\n            }\n            C[i * N + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Simple validation: compute a single element and compare\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B,\n                   const std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) {\n    // Check a few random positions\n    constexpr size_t checkPoints[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4};\n    \n    for (size_t pi = 0; pi < 5; ++pi) {\n        for (size_t pj = 0; pj < 5; ++pj) {\n            const size_t i = checkPoints[pi] % N;\n            const size_t j = checkPoints[pj] % N;\n            \n            double expected = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                expected += A[i * N + k] * B[k * N + j];\n            }\n            \n            const double actual = C[i * N + j];\n            const double relError = std::abs((actual - expected) / (expected + 1e-10));\n            \n            if (relError > 1e-6) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at (%zu, %zu): expected %.10f, got %.10f (error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, j, expected, actual, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size N (computes NxN * NxN) (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t N = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            N = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Matrix Multiplication Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", N, N);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrices\n    std::vector<double> A(N * N);\n    std::vector<double> B(N * N);\n    std::vector<double> C(N * N);\n    \n    // Initialize matrices\n    printf(\"Initializing matrices...\\n\");\n    initMatrix(A, N);\n    initMatrix(B, N);\n    \n    // Perform matrix multiplication\n    printf(\"Computing matrix multiplication...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    matrixMultiply(A, B, C, N);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate GFLOPS\n    double gflops = (2.0 * N * N * N) / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(C, \"MatrixC\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateResult(A, B, C, N);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01RvYN8A5JkyaMjdzzQE1eSz","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

Each C element accumulates its k-terms in\n// increasing k order, exactly as the sequential reference does. The explicit\n// __dmul_rn/__dadd_rn keep the same rounding as the host code (no FMA contraction).\n__global__ void matmulKernel(const double* __restrict__ A, const double* __restrict__ B,\n                             double* __restrict__ C, const size_t rows, const size_t N) {\n    __shared__ double As[TILE][TILE];\n    __shared__ double Bs[TILE][TILE];\n\n    const size_t row = blockIdx.y * TILE + threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t col = blockIdx.x * TILE + threadIdx.x;\n    double sum = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t kt = 0; kt < N; kt += TILE) {\n        const size_t ka = kt + threadIdx.x;\n        const size_t kb = kt + threadIdx.y;\n        As[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x] = (row < rows && ka < N) ? CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&numDevices));\n    if (numDevices == 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA devices found on rank %d\\n\", rank);\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    const std::vector<int> devices = assignDevices(nodeRank, nodeSize, numDevices);\n\n    // Row block owned by this rank\n    const size_t rowStart = rowBegin(N, rank, size);\n    const size_t rowEnd =                                 \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                      \\\n        }                                                                      \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// CUDA tiling: each thread block computes a BM x BN tile of C in steps of BK over k,\n// with each thread holding a TM x TN register block of C\nconstexpr size_t BM = 64;\nconstexpr size_t BN = 64;\nconstexpr size_t BK = 16;\nconstexpr size_t TM = 4;\nconstexpr size_t TN = 4;\nconstexpr int THREADS = (BM / TM) * (BN / TN);\n\nconstexpr size_t GPU_CHUNK = 128; i < rowEnd; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            mat[(i - rowBegin) * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, i, j);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// C[rows x N] = A[rows x N] * B[N x N]. r < TM; ++r) a[r] = As[threadIdx.y * TM + r][kk];\n            for (size_t c = 0; c < TN; ++c) b[c] = Bs[kk][threadIdx.x * TN + c];\n            for (size_t r = 0; r < TM; ++r) {\n                for (size_t c = 0; c < TN; ++c) {\n                    acc[r][c] = __dadd_rn(acc[r][c], __dmul_rn(a[r], b[c]));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < TM; ++r) {\n        const size_t gr = rowBase + threadIdx.y * TM + r;\n        if (gr >= rows) continue;\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < TN; ++c) {\n            const size_t gc = colBase + threadIdx.x * TN + c;\n            if (gc < N) C[gr * N + gc] = acc[r][c];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Drives one GPU: repeatedly claims a chunk of local rows and computes it on the device\nvoid gpuWorker(const int device, const double* Al, const double* B, double* Cl,\n               const size_t localRows, const size_t N, std::atomic<size_t>& nextRow) {\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));\n\n    const size_t chunkMax = std::min(GPU_CHUNK, localRows);\n    double *dA = nullptr, *dB = nullptr, *dC = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dA, chunkMax * N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dB, N * N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dC, chunkMax * N * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dB, B, N * N * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const dim3 block(BN / TN, BM / TM);\n    for (size_t begin = nextRow.fetch_add(GPU_CHUNK); Only `matmul/matmul.cpp` and `matmul/CMakeLists.txt` changed, the executable is still `matmul`, and I created no new files.\n\n**Design**\n- **MPI:** rows of C are split into contiguous blocks, one per rank. Each rank holds all of B and only its own rows of A and C. The timing is the slowest rank's time.\n- **CUDA:** a register-blocked double-precision kernel (64×64 block tile, 4×4 per thread). Each C element accumulates k in increasing order.\n- **OpenMP:** one thread per local GPU. Threads pull 128-row chunks from a shared counter, so faster GPUs take more work. OpenMP also parallelizes the matrix initialization.\n- **GPU assignment:** GPUs are split round-robin across the ranks of a node. If there are more ranks than GPUs, ranks share devices.\n- **Unconditional:** CMake requires MPI, OpenMP and CUDA, and there is no CPU fallback. The default architectures are 70–90; override with `-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=native`.\n- **Dependencies:** none beyond the requested MPI, OpenMP and CUDA. I did not use cuBLAS, because it wouldn't give bit-identical results.\n\n**Decision for you:** the CPU cores do no matrix work. Splitting work between CPU and GPU would need tuning I could not measure here, so I left it out. That makes its output depend on the compiler's vectorization. At N=33, 11 elements differ from strict IEEE arithmetic, so the `-r` hash differs from the original at sizes like 33, 37 and 65. I used strict rounding (`__dmul_rn` and `__dadd_rn`), which matches the original's results and is reproducible across rank and GPU counts. On FP64-limited GPUs this roughly halves the kernel's throughput. Switching to FMA is a one-line change if you'd rather have speed than bit-exactness.\n\n**Performance (N=4096, 4× RTX 3090, FP64):**\n\n| Ranks | Time | GFLOPS |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | 228 ms | 603 |\n| 2 | 215 ms | 639 |\n| 4 | 216 ms | 636 |\n\nI did not get a measured GFLOPS number for the original: its single-threaded N=4096 run did not finish in over 10 minutes, and I stopped it. The GPU timings exclude CUDA context creation and host-memory pinning, which are set up before the timer starts. They include copying B to each GPU."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1171,"cache_read_input_tokens":118346,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1171},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"5739f3fc-f4e2-4fb5-9fa0-fb19d2a26022","uuid":"830957ce-9dbe-4119-84b4-78b8246c4705","timestamp":"2026-10-13T05:14:29.825Z","request_id":"req_011CfyfZN1x2NQBcq2k1spJY"}
